'''2007 Worlds Day 2 J.W. Miller LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[J.W. Miller]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck title Same Ole. Sheet name J.W. Millet → published as [[J.W. Miller]] (matches DS sheet). Line 48 Sense & Recoil struck → [[Sorry About The Mess & •Blaster Proficiency]].


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[J.W. Miller]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Plead My Case To The Senate / Power Of The Senate|Plead My Case To The Senate]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
